exposure: Gestational age at birth (preterm vs. full-term)
outcome: Frequency of poor repertoire of writhing movements
Types and characteristics of spontaneous orofacial movements
cohort: The study included 51 preterm infants (born between 28 and 36 weeks) and 43 full-term infants.
finding: All spontaneous orofacial movements were present both in preterm and full-term infants, albeit with higher frequency, intensity, and variability at fidgety age.
gest_age:
Preterm: 28-36 weeks 
Full-term: Not specified, but likely 37 weeks or later
followup_time: Age corresponding to writhing and fidgety general movement ages (approximately 2-5 months)
